{{Top|leg}}
'''Tarnree''' was a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who lived in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. The bartender was acquainted with a group of adventurers who visited him every time they were in town, and he often told them jokes.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
